notes.title: Launcher update
notes.content:
Hello,

the old launcher was often misused and lead players to play in the minimum windowed resolution. With this update we restructured and beautified the launcher to be more intuitive:


 removing the save button
 saving is now done automatically on launching the game or editor
 higher launcher resolution & a nice background picture


We also fixed errors in the mission texts, which was long necessary.

We hope, you enjoy the changes!

Stay healthy!

Kind regards,
Warptear Entertainment
